description: cowork24 helps users discover coworking desks, private offices and meeting rooms in Swiss cities, plus airport lounges at international airports. Users search by city and see results on a map with price markers next to a synced list of photo cards carrying live CHF prices from cowork24.ch; they can open a detail view with photos, the exact price, the amenities the host listed and how booking and cancellation work; check which time slots a space still has free in Swiss local time; get an exact price breakdown computed by the marketplace's own pricing engine rather than estimated; and prepare a booking summary that ends in a secure link to complete the reservation on cowork24.ch. No payment, card entry or reservation ever happens inside the chat. Where cowork24 has no spaces in a location, the app says so instead of returning listings from a different city.
